Page 2 • Corporate Profile

About DreamsAdverstings

DreamsAdverstings is a technology-driven Outdoor (OOH), Digital Out-of-Home (DOOH), Media Planning, and Brand Activation agency and marketplace headquartered in Pune, Maharashtra, engineered to scale across India.

Transparency Note: As a newly launched agency platform, no historical awards, legacy founding dates, or unverified client claims are fabricated. All operational counters reflect live database records.

Our Vision

To make outdoor and digital out-of-home media buying across Pune and India as transparent, measurable, and frictionless as programmatic digital advertising.

Our Mission

To connect brands, media agencies, and verified outdoor asset owners through one unified platform with standardized GPS discovery, automated GST quotations, conflict-free booking holds, and audited proof-of-display execution.

Core Values

  • • 100% Inventory Verification: Only admin-vetted vendors can publish bookable media.
  • • Pricing Integrity: Authoritative backend calculations with zero hidden markups.
  • • Execution Accountability: Timestamped proof-of-display photo verification.
